title:
Application wrapper.

It adds all needed providers to ensure components can work
(I18n, Redux State, Data Context , etc).

It is used from the index.tsx entry point and from componentRenderer
to render pages and components in the right context.

By default it will use the SDL.DefaultDataContext component with its
SDL.DefaultSite to add redux data operations. For more control over
the DataContext or the UiSdlSite, you can pass the children prop to replace
the SDL.DefaultDataContext.
